reviews.text: So pleased to get the help I need  for my GSP Bea. I was struggling with her being nervous and extremely reactive to other dogs and I have had such great results with the tools that have been shown to me and Bea from Friendly Creatures kind and patient trainers. She is now great with strangers and doing so well with other dogs - I’m happier as Bea is happy and this has transformed our relationship. Thank you!!
Lydia offers great advice and knowledge about training our rescue puppy. She is our go-to person when it comes to dogs .

Our 4 year-old Labrador would go off and hunt at a distance across the field, often out of sight.
We were given great advice to make the area we were standing in an exciting hunting place. This was simply achieved by scattering several pieces of carrot by us. Call Suzie back and ask her to "seek". She found this very exciting and over a short period of time was aware and sensitive to this happening , and now keeps a constant eye on us . No more disappearing on her own to hunt.
Thanks Katie!
Was a really relaxed and informative experience.

I could not recommend Martina highly enough. My Winnie really turned a corner and her reactivity has massively improved because I now know what works for her. It will take continued practice but I am now (2 years and a dozen different courses later) seeing a way forward. The greatest improvement though has been her pulling on the lead. From start to finish it’s been an absolute pleasure.

I did an hour's agility taster course with Friendly Creatures with my dog Womble and it was wonderful. I've always thought my dog would be good at agility as I made a little course in my garden so it was a lovely experience to use real equipment. I learnt so much in that hour and have used a lot of what I was taught since. The trainers lived up to their name and were very friendly. They were also very knowledgeable and helpful. Everyone had a turn at using the equipment with their dogs and there was a lovely atmosphere all round. I am seriously considering doing the six week course in the future. Thank you so much Friendly Creatures... Womble and I loved every minute!
Really excellent training, and Martina was an excellent trainer. We really noticed the impact on our puppy after training. Great support throughout!

Martina at friendly creatures is amazing! She is so kind, caring and knowledgeable and gives great advice. Before booking I wasn't sure what to expect and was a little nervous to start but Martina is so lovely and welcomed us with open arms.
Martina offers such a wealth of knowledge which is put into practice in the class! Now we've just completed our 6 week reactivity training course and we're so much more confident! It has really strengthened my bond with my boy and I feel like I know what to do when were in situations that trigger his reactivity and what to do (where possible) to prevent him from reacting in the first place. Now I don't dread my walks with Neo! Absolutely a 5 star experience you wont regret it!
Very supportive online training for my young puppy. Looking forward to trying out the classes in person
Absolutely excellent course - thank you so much Vanda, it was the highlight of our week, every week

We took our dachshund to Friendly Creatures at the end of last year and Vanda was brilliant. We’ve really improved the way we engage and train him and feel we understand him so much better. Not only that but we made friends with other dog owners and now understand how our dogs brain and motivation works! Would highly recommend to anyone wanting to connect and train with their dog or puppy - whatever the age.
Great start to understand how to train your puppy. Very friendly.

Me & my puppy Lily loved our Sunday classes.
The training was well structured & the science behind everything was explained.
Really appreciate it thank you!
Thanks Sean!
He was very aggressive and hostile he is not trained well you guys are just glazing get a life.

I have an old rescue dog from Romania. I’ve had multiple trainers before but not much have actually worked.
I went into this, not thinking much of it, but let’s try.

I have to say it’s been a real transformation. My dog is still reactive but now I have learned to manage it. And week by week I can feel she’s getting better and walks are getting much more enjoyable for the both of us.

I know the training is all about me and how well I do it now going forward but it has reignited such a big motivation to see that we are capable to have a great  life together.

Thank you loads to Marta!!!

We took the puppy course. This was the best investment we could make for our puppy and learning the basics. Vanda has been phenomenal! To the point that we are taking the foundations course as he is now 6 months and want to reinforce that learning.

We also took a private class from another company and it was day and night compared to what Vanda brought to our puppy.

Trainer Vanda have help me with positive approach to train our “bag of beans”. After few sessions we have gained understanding how to approach our puppy and we get to see immediate  improvements. Thank you again
Great Agility course with Martina. We've been participating in it for 4 months, making significant progress and continuing our classes. The dog absolutely loves such training.
Always wonderful to be with Martina - she gives great tips and answers to all our questions!
Martina was so friendly and patient! Both we and our puppy learned a lot. Would highly recommend
Lydia is incredibly empathetic and knowledgeable and really took the time to listen to our concerns and give us the appropriate practical steps.
We have done a few training courses with Friendly Creatures and have found them really useful. The trainers are great and we have learnt a lot.
We loved the fun agility! Martina is an excellent teacher. Highly recommend this course. ❤️

Could not recommend enough - Holly at Friendly Creatures really helped us understand our puppy better and have seen so much improvement since taking part. We learned so much about our puppy's behaviours and how to get the best out of him and for him. Thank you!
The team is amazing, and our dog is so well adapted to our family after the training. I love how much they care about results and their deep knowledge! We will come back for more. Great job!

We did Lydia’s online puppy training course and it was fantastic! Lydia was super helpful, really friendly, and explained everything in a way that was easy to follow. After each session, she sent a follow-up email with a summary of what we covered, which made it so much easier to practice at home. The course really helped build our puppy’s confidence and ours too. We’d definitely recommend Lydia to anyone looking for puppy training support!
Martina has a wealth of knowledge and is very attentive towards my dogs needs. I am very happy with the training provided. the videos are very helpful as well. would highly recommend!
We attended a six week puppy course, really pleased with the experience. Our trainer Marta was excellent!

Lydia and the puppy training is the best possible start you can give your dog. Her wisdom and insight is just phenomenal, before my puppy did something she’d anticipate it and in the calmest possible voice let me know what to do, and how to spot it next time. In the 4 weeks while we were waiting for vaccines to take affect, Ninja had learnt sit, touch, paw, down, on your mat, lead walking, find it, toilet and go to bed. I can’t recommend highly enough and look forward to joining an in person class soon. Thanks for being our “Fairy Dogmother’ Lydia, you’re utterly wonderful!!
Such a lovely training group - we did the puppy training and just did the beginner’s flyball. Martina is a joy!
Had a great time at the introduction to agility workshop. It was a really fun session and learnt a lot in just an hour. Would definitely recommend!
Thanks Sabrina :)

We have learned so much with Friendly Creatures and can’t thank the team enough! Our Bernese Mountain Dog puppy Ernie has gone through a few different classes, including some 121 sessions! We have also learned so much about his behaviour and what signs to look out for in him and other dogs.

He is an excitable, lovely boy so we’re so glad we found FC and trainers Martina and Lydia and such a supportive community! I’m sure we will continue to come back for more sessions in the future!
Really helpful training, tips and cues which have helped build strong foundations for us to cope better with a reactive dog.
Really set our Dog up, noticed a marked progression every week. Fully recommend
I took a reactive training course for my excitable pup. Was a great course, I learned a lot and it has really helped to calm my dog when needed.

We have attended Friendly Creatures scent work and beginner agility classes. They classes are fun and accessible. We are returning for intermediate agility after Christmas and are really looking forward to it.
Martina is an incredible instructor. Toshi and I have loved every minute of our agility training course!

Enrolled on the 'Excitable/ Reactive' dog course with Friendly Creatures which was really helpful for us and our dog. We picked up some good tips over six sessions to help re-focus his attention back on us whilst navigating walks with distractions around. Martina is a friendly and patient trainer who is great at observing and helping us improve our techniques. We'd recommend this course for any dog owners who'd like to better understand how they could re-focus their dog's attention away from distractions.

This course has been the best decision we’ve made and we will continue training with Friendly Creatures in the future! We are actually already booked for an online seminar - Understanding Body Language.

Martina was amazing, super knowledgeable, friendly, kind, always there to help and advise, and our puppy loved it too! Thank you so much Martina and we look forward to seeing you soon:) (Tereza+Josh+Bruce)

Friendly Creatures was a really good learning experience for our Romanian rescue dog. We got her at 6 months, and then about 5 months later joined the foundation course and it really helped us drill the basics that she hadn’t mastered. She’s really grown since doing the 6-week course. Thanks Vanda!

Fantastic courses, we've done puppy training, agility and scentwork. They are such good fun and have really cemented the bond between me and my dog. The trainers are friendly and very knowlegable ... I can't recommend  Friendly Creatures too highly

Taken my dogs to many classes, agility and puppy training, they have all been great fun for both owner and pooch.
Staff are also very knowledgeable.
Will definitely be back at some point.

Great dog training courses! Our trainer Vanda was amazing and the course has helped us and our puppy tremendously when it comes to necessary life skills. The courses are well structured and the choice in locations was great as well.
Friendly environment, our doggies had a blast at their agility lessons!
Fantastic, positive reinforcement puppy training and a must for anyone with a puppy

Martina is a very knowledgable trainer and immensely personable. Taking the Excitable/Reactive dog training course was insightful and helpful. A lot of the course is based on clicker training and will require further work with your dog.
Worth noting that most of the dogs on the course seemed to be more in the "excitable" category, not "reactive".
Really enjoyed the Agility Course. Marina is a very friendly, positive coach who gets the best out of the dogs with helpful tips and lots of patience

My dog absolutely loves the agility classes! Most importantly, it's about fun for the dogs, and there's never any pressure on them to 'perform'. Each trainer I've worked with has been brilliant, and has helped us not only during the class, but also given us great tips for every day life with a silly sausage dog ;)

All round great experience, worth every penny! Martina was professional, friendly, so knowledgeable, helpful with encouraging both myself and my dog. Loved every second. Thank you Martina. We’ll be seeing you for the next course!

Our daughter (9) took this course as she’s ben training our dog. This is what she had to say, “It was amazing and Coco loved it. Coco found it exciting and I thought it was a very good course in a good place.”

My little cockapoo who is very ball obsessed had a great time at the flyball session! This is the second time I've been to friendly creatures - we did the beginner's agility course with them last year and it was great fun.  I'm already looking at what course he can go to next! Thanks so much Lydia and team from a very happy owner and dog.
Great experience! Got in touch via email and got a prompt reply, really helpful telephone consultation and then booked in with a fantastic trainer. Really recommend Lydia & team!
Very positive and encouraging trainer.
Many thanks:)

We did the Excitable/ Reactive Dog Course with Martina and it was fantastic.

I see it more as "human training" as it's given us some really good tools and techniques to help our little doggo be less reactive.

We signed up for the 6 week puppy classes. WOW! What a great series of classes and really has help to lay the foundationst in understanding puppies and their behavior. Really helpful in learning to work with a highly energetic puppy as a new owner... and most of the training was for me!

Can't recommend Friendly Creatures enough, really helped me understand my puppy RZA better and how to manage puppy life.

A special shout out to Martina for her approach to puppy training and her patience and calmness. She really was inspirational in her approach.

I'll be looking at the next set up courses to get RZA onto to continue our learning experience.
thank you
